from pathlib import Path
import base64,difflib,hashlib,io,json,subprocess,tempfile,zipfile
root=Path('products/distribution/sqlite-instructor-pilot')
folder=root/'reconciliation'
live=folder/'live-index.html'
patch=root/'placement/index.diff'
payload=root/'placement/sqlite-preview.zip.b64'
site=Path('products/sites/sqlite-statement-diagnostic/index.html')
sha=lambda data: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
live_bytes=live.read_bytes()
site_bytes=site.read_bytes()
archive=base64.b64decode(payload.read_bytes().strip(),validate=True)
assert sha(live_bytes)=='1dbcaa64a3f399c03612ce1c999e342fc901727ed4889bfee83a0afc7bcd78db'
assert sha(archive)=='8325a93711826740de4fffb9d43a312b048b26a43212280fd53df55fb5c11eb2'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
 p=Path(temp)
 preview=p/'preview.html'
 subprocess.run(['patch','--batch','--fuzz=0','-o',str(preview),str(live),str(patch)],check=True)
 restored=p/'restored.html'
 subprocess.run(['patch','--batch','--fuzz=0','-R','-o',str(restored),str(preview),str(patch)],check=True)
 assert restored.read_bytes()==live_bytes
 assert 'href="sqlite-preview.zip"' in preview.read_text()
 with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(archive)) as z:
  assert set(z.namelist())=={'README.md','after.sql','before.sql','run.py','seed.sql'}
  learner=p/'learner'
  z.extractall(learner)
 run=subprocess.run(['python3','run.py'],cwd=learner,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
 print(run.stdout)
 candidate=preview.read_bytes()
assert sha(candidate)=='ef9f8dc368fa7485bd23d2f7cb91d11381e31af3d3bea58d8c75d68b7ce3adad'
changes=''.join(difflib.unified_diff(live_bytes.decode().splitlines(True),site_bytes.decode().splitlines(True),fromfile='served-index.html',tofile='shared-candidate-index.html'))
(folder/'shared-candidate-changes.diff').write_text(changes)
proof=dict(live_sha256=sha(live_bytes),shared_candidate_sha256=sha(site_bytes),preview_index_sha256=sha(candidate),archive_sha256=sha(archive),reverse_restores_live=True,learner_command='python3 run.py',learner_exit=run.returncode,learner_stdout=run.stdout,standalone_patch=str(patch),payload=str(payload),decision='Standalone preview verified against fresh live baseline. Shared candidate carries separate bilingual private quote changes. Site files untouched. Public deployment requires an independently approved exact digest.')
(folder/'standalone-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(proof))
